content_data.project_title: Real-Time Network Anomaly Detection Engine for Telecom Infrastructure
content_data.project_description: Development of a machine learning-powered system to predict and identify network anomalies across European telecommunications infrastructure, reducing downtime and improving service quality through proactive intervention.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) for architecture and data pipeline setup, Phase 2 (months 5-10) for ML model development and testing, and Phase 3 (months 11-14) for deployment and optimization
objectives: Ensure GDPR compliance and data privacy standards across all European markets
Create comprehensive API layer for integration with existing network management systems
deliverables: Comprehensive test suite with 85%+ code coverage
Technical documentation and system architecture diagrams
Training materials and knowledge transfer sessions for operations team
success_metrics: Mean time to detection (MTTD) reduced by 65% compared to current manual monitoring
False positive rate below 8% within first 3 months of production deployment
API response time under 100ms for 95th percentile requests
Successfully deployed across at least 3 major European telecom partners
Prediction accuracy reaches 92% or higher for critical network failures
